label: es-e4b6
change: The Android host becomes the engine library NTSDAndroidHost with the C target CAndroidNative (with NTSD_ANDROID=1): NTSDAndroidApp, NTSDAndroidAudio, NTSDAndroidGamepads, NTSDAndroidHost and CAndroidNative (entry.c with ANativeActivity_onCreate, sha256.c, the header) by git mv. NTSDAndroidApp takes the OriginalGame and the content bundle's folder name (resources, formerly the literal NTSDNative_NTSDContent.bundle, SwiftPM's name for the game's target) and passes the game to the session host (content and identity through it instead of NTSDContent); public NTSDAndroidHost.create(_:game:resources:) forwards to it. The @_cdecl("ntsd_android_on_create") function the C entry calls stays in the game's dynamic library NTSDAndroid (NTSDAndroidEntry.swift) as its one call. android_speed.py's 'Android window drawing' phase matches the draw's new mangled form too.
checks: a clean APK build (NTSD_ANDROID_SCRATCH on NTSD-Builds) and the emulator's vs: equal, 1,832 frames identical to android-app-ref
libNTSDAndroid.so: ANativeActivity_onCreate exported (T), ntsd_android_on_create local (t), the same binding as es-e4b5's APK

review.by: a separate read-only agent, 2026-10-19, on the staged diff, then on the fix
review.verdict: equivalent: the entry path and its order, the arguments' order (args.txt, --events-file, --tz, --resources with the same literal, --music-dir), content and identity through runtimeGame; the C entry resolves the game's hidden symbol within the one shared object and stays a root under --gc-sections; the game's import CAndroidNative is sound (module maps of reachable C targets); swift settings identical (FreeType include, exclusivity, no CMO), 2,161 swift_beginAccess calls in both libraries, and every host function the same size except startIfReady, deinits, contentLocation and game
review.required: android_speed.py keyed the window host's draw on WindowHostC4draw, which the module rename mangles as 0a6WindowB0C4draw: a --profile run would have reported that phase as 0%
review.fixed: the phase takes a tuple of both forms (each library has exactly one match: old 1/0, new 0/1); confirmed by the reviewer (no other PHASES entry or consumer affected)
adopted: the card's identity strings list Android's program name NTSDAndroid (argv[0])
notes: String(reflecting:) of DataError in the androidDataError event now prints the NTSDAndroidHost module: a failure-path diagnostic only, consumed by nothing
other studies' 'Allowed paths' scope lines (CORE_REALTIME.md, MEMORY_LOADING.md) left unchanged, as for E4a's moves
